'''Dante Lamar Cunningham''' (born April 22, 1987) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] before being selected with the 33rd overall pick in the [[2009 NBA draft]] by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].

==Early life==
Cunningham was born in [[Clinton, Maryland]], to Searcy Blankenship and Ron Cunningham. His older sister [[Davalyn Cunningham|Davalyn]] played in the [[WNBA]].<ref name=villanovacom>{{cite web|url=http://www.villanova.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/cunningham_dante00.html|title=Dante Cunningham Profile|year=2009|publisher=CBS Interactive|work=Villanova.com|access-date=2009-03-29|archive-date=2011-07-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717204335/http://www.villanova.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/cunningham_dante00.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==High school career==
Cunningham began his prep career at [[St. John's College High School]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] While a junior, he averaged 10 points per game and 7.4 rebounds. One of his teammates, [[Dwayne Anderson]], would later play at Villanova with Cunningham.<ref name=villanovacom/>

As a senior, Cunningham transferred to [[Potomac High School (Oxon Hill, Maryland)|Potomac High School]], which he led to a 27–0 season under Head Coach Rico Reed. He averaged 13 rebounds, 20 points, and four blocked shots per game at Potomac. He was honored as ''[[The Washington Post]]'' Metropolitan Player of the Year.<ref name=villanovacom/>

==College career==
[[File:Dante Cunningham at the Palestra in Philadelphia PA in 2008.jpg|thumb|right|Dante Cunningham at the Palestra in [[Philadelphia]] in November 2008]]
At [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]]  Cunningham played in all 33 games and was a starter in four during his [[2005–06 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|freshman year]].<ref name=villanovacom/>

In his [[2008–09 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|senior year]], Cunningham would go on to lead the team in scoring with 16.1 points and take home the [[Big East Conference|Big East]] [[Big East Conference Men's Basketball Most Improved Player|Most Improved Player award]]. He led the Wildcats to their first Final Four appearance since 1985. Cunningham was named to the 2008–2009 [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All Big East]] second team and the 2009 NCAA Tournament All Region .

==Professional career==

===Portland Trail Blazers (2009–2011)===
Cunningham was drafted 33rd overall by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in the [[2009 NBA draft]]. He played for Portland's [[NBA Summer League|Las Vegas Summer League]] team where he averaged over 18 points and 5 rebounds per game in four contests. On August 21, 2009, Cunningham signed his rookie scale contract with the Trail Blazers.<ref>Joe Freeman, [http://blog.oregonlive.com/behindblazersbeat/2009/08/blazers_sign_draft_pick_dante.html Blazers sign draft pick Dante Cunningham], August 21, 2009</ref>

===Charlotte Bobcats (2011)===
On February 24, 2011, Cunningham was traded, along with [[Joel Przybilla]], [[Sean Marks]] and two future first-round draft picks, to the [[Charlotte Bobcats]] in exchange for [[Gerald Wallace]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_portland_trade_110224.html | title = Cunningham, Przybilla, Marks, 2 First Round Picks Acquired from Portland | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2011-02-24 | access-date = 2011-02-25 | url-status = dead | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20110628201955/http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_portland_trade_110224.html | archive-date = 2011-06-28 }}</ref>

===Memphis Grizzlies (2011–2012)===
On December 20, 2011, Cunningham received a three-year, $7 million offer sheet from the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/cunningham_offer_sheet-111220 | title = Grizzlies tender offer sheet to Dante Cunningham | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2011-12-20 | access-date = 2011-12-22}}</ref> The Bobcats declined to match the offer and subsequently signed the contract with the Grizzlies.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies_sign_cunningham-111224 | title = Grizzlies sign Dante Cunningham | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2011-12-24 | access-date = 2011-12-25}}</ref>

===Minnesota Timberwolves (2012–2014)===
[[File:20140101 Dante Cunningham3.JPG|thumb|right|Cunningham with the Timberwolves in January 2014]]
On July 24, 2012, Cunningham was traded to the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] in exchange for [[Wayne Ellington]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/wolves-acquire-dante-cunningham-memphis Wolves Acquire Dante Cunningham From Memphis]</ref>

===New Orleans Pelicans (2014–2018)===
On December 4, 2014, Cunningham signed with the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-sign-dante-cunningham|title=Pelicans Sign Dante Cunningham|work=NBA.com|date=December 4, 2014|access-date=July 20, 2017}}</ref> On July 9, 2015, he re-signed with the Pelicans.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-re-sign-ajinca-asik-and-cunningham|title=Pelicans Re-Sign Ajinca, Asik and Cunningham|work=NBA.com|date=July 9, 2015|access-date=July 9, 2015}}</ref> On September 25, 2017, he re-signed with the Pelicans.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-re-sign-dante-cunningham|title=Pelicans re-sign Dante Cunningham|work=NBA.com|date=September 25, 2017|access-date=September 25, 2017}}</ref>

===Brooklyn Nets (2018)===
On February 8, 2018, Cunningham was traded to the [[Brooklyn Nets]] in exchange for [[Rashad Vaughn]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets Acquire Dante Cunningham From New Orleans|url=http://www.nba.com/nets/news/2018/02/08/brooklyn-nets-acquire-dante-cunningham-new-orleans|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 9, 2018|date=February 8, 2018}}</ref>

===San Antonio Spurs (2018–2019)===
On July 20, 2018, Cunningham signed with the [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref>{{cite web |title=SPURS SIGN DANTE CUNNINGHAM |url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-sign-dante-cunningham |website=NBA.com |access-date=July 20, 2018 |date=July 20, 2018}}</ref>

===Fujian Sturgeons (2019–2020)===
On December 11, 2019, Cunningham was listed in the squad of [[Fujian Sturgeons]] and made his debut for [[Fujian Sturgeons]] on the next day, scoring fourteen points and collecting eight rebounds in a 111–107 win over the [[Beijing Ducks]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Fujian upsets Beijing 111–107 in CBA|url=http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-12/12/c_138626552.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191212191306/http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-12/12/c_138626552.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=December 12, 2019|date=December 12, 2019|website=xinhuanet.com|access-date=December 12, 2019}}</ref> He averaged 15 points and 7 rebounds per game.<ref name="cangrejeros" />

===Cangrejeros de Santurce (2021)===
On July 7, 2021, Cunningham signed with the [[Cangrejeros de Santurce (basketball)|Cangrejeros de Santurce]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]].<ref name="cangrejeros">{{cite news |title=Cangrejeros de Santurce part ways with Anthony Bennett, ink Dante Cunningham |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/cangrejeros-de-santurce-part-ways-with-anthony-bennett-ink-dante-cunningham/ |website=Sportando |access-date=August 27, 2021 |date=July 7, 2021|last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }}</ref> In 10 games, he averaged 11.5 points, 6.1 rebounds, 1.6 steals and 1.1 assists per game.<ref name="yahyabeyoglu" />

===Le Mans Sarthe Basket (2021–2022)===
On August 27, 2021, Cunningham signed with [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].<ref name="yahyabeyoglu">{{cite web |last1=Yahyabeyoglu |first1=Fersu |title=Dante Cunningham (ex Santurce) is a newcomer at Le Mans |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/France/news/702128/Dante-Cunningham-(ex-Santurce)-is-a-newcomer-at-Le-Mans |website=Eurobasket |access-date=August 27, 2021 |date=August 27, 2021}}</ref>

==Personal life==
On April 3, 2014, Cunningham was arrested for allegedly choking his girlfriend with whom he lived. Three days later, he was arrested on alleged domestic abuse charges.<ref>[http://nba.si.com/2014/04/06/dante-cunningham-arrested-timberwolves-threats/ Timberwolves' Dante Cunningham arrested for second time this week]</ref> By August 18, 2014, charges were dropped, due to evidence Cunningham's then girlfriend had fabricated her accusations.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20141023171516/http://www.kare11.com/story/sports/nba/timberwolves/2014/08/18/felony-assault-charge-against-cunningham-dropped/14266681/|title=Felony assault charge against Cunningham dropped}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.startribune.com/sports/wolves/280155462.html/ |title=NBA free agent Dante Cunningham struggles to clear name after domestic violence charge dropped |website=[[Star Tribune]] |access-date=2014-10-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141023122214/http://www.startribune.com/sports/wolves/280155462.html |archive-date=2014-10-23 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Cunningham was included on a preliminary list for [[Great Britain national basketball team|Great Britain]]'s [[Eurobasket 2009]] qualifying matches in 2008.<ref>{{cite news| url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/other_sports/basketball/7324570.stm | work=BBC News | title=Gordon is named in Britain squad | date=April 1, 2008 | access-date=May 1, 2010}}</ref> However, he was later ruled ineligible to compete for Britain after an investigation by British Basketball officials into his ancestral ties failed to prove his case to receive UK citizenship.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.mvp247.com/2012/02/mullens-for-gb/ |title=MULLENS TO JOIN GB'S OLYMPIC TILT |access-date=February 6, 2013 |archive-date=August 25, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220825134422/http://www.mvp247.com/2012/02/mullens-for-gb/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
